classification: exposed development postmortem; not a benchmark, no model run

challenge.name: Mandiant
challenge.freshness: Previously evaluated and exposed; retrospective only

artifact_match.match_evidence: The PDF linked from the pinned public writeup has the exact same SHA-256 as the pinned NYU CTF Bench PDF. The postmortem then re-extracted its attachment, decoded the PNG, parsed PNG chunks through IEND, extracted the appended 7z, decoded its Base64 member, and reproduced the exact JPEG hash from the prior Luna workspace and pinned challenge artifact.

ffc_findings.tool_version: Free File Camouflage 1.25 freeware .NET/WinForms PE32 assembly
ffc_findings.download_source: AfterDawn legacy software download, version 1.25; publisher URL returned 404
format_observations_from_static_binary_a: first encrypted record contains FFC version, embedded MD5 and original filename metadata
subsequent records independently decrypt to file data chunks
AES-CBC with PKCS#7; application password bytes are padded with equals signs for key and IV inputs
ffc_findings.native_application_execution: Not completed: the local Mono runtime lacks Microsoft.VisualBasic v8.0 required by this WinForms assembly. Instead, a small compatibility extractor was implemented from the observed version-1.25 format and its embedded MD5 verified the complete recovered payload.
ffc_findings.default_secret_handling: The version-specific built-in password was recovered from the freeware binary for this postmortem and kept only in ignored runs/_postmortem data. It is not present in the committed helper or Skills V2 reference.

reproduction.workspace: runs/_postmortem/mandiant-ffc-2026-11-08/ (gitignored, separate from original solver workspace)
steps: PDF attachment Base64 decoded into PNG; PNG chunks parsed to IEND; appended 7z carved and extracted; member Base64 decoded into JPEG.
Recovered JPEG matched original player-side JPEG SHA-256 d924904e78d7ffe37477387a60c5ded6d30e974604bdd0fde5cb58a2c645e7c7.
Compatibility helper decrypted FFC metadata and payload records; embedded MD5 passed; recovered 13,437-byte ELF SHA-256 889b2ac23fd0b3c8d63051e6821d2b62f0d1f07d42c2c5f26fd9fc1a2dac1ae6.

Recovered ELF was executed with bwrap network namespace disabled, no home directory mounted, read-only system mounts, a read-only challenge binary mount, 2-second CPU limit, 256-MiB address-space limit, one-process limit, 1-MiB file-size limit, and 3-second wall timeout.
Its output matched the answer printed in the public writeup. This is writeup-assisted reproduction, not independent answer discovery or verifier evaluation.
reproduction.time_or_model_usage: No model use; elapsed time was not measured.

luna_comparison.previous_attempt: Original Luna Medium trajectory remains unchanged: 22 rounds, 3599.002 seconds, no candidate; wall-time interrupted.
luna_comparison.missed_step: Luna correctly found and segmented the JPEG trailer but treated its decoded 64-byte and 13,440-byte records as generic key material and ciphertext, trying direct/common cipher layouts. It did not recognize or search for the versioned Free File Camouflage container and its fixed-default-password record format.
luna_comparison.important_limit: The public writeup says the competition solve depended on an organizer chat hint naming Free File Camouflage. The archived player artifacts alone did not provide a demonstrated direct identification signal. The retrospective therefore does not prove Luna should have inferred the exact proprietary tool from ciphertext alone.

independent_validation.fixtures: Two separately generated benign JPEG carriers with different contents and known binary payloads; one payload crossed the 2-MB chunk boundary. The tested parser recovered exact bytes and metadata name in both cases.
independent_validation.negative_controls: Missing sentinel, wrong password, and tampered encrypted record were rejected.
independent_validation.skill_helper_test: 2/2 tests passed; PyCryptodome AES-CBC and embedded MD5 checks exercised.
independent_validation.scope: Validates parsing/decryption of documented version-1.25-style containers, not arbitrary steganography methods or solve-rate improvement.

skills_v2.change: Added focused Free File Camouflage reference, safe parameterized extractor, and benign tests; added one route in ctf-forensics/SKILL.md.
skills_v2.limitations: Reference includes no challenge flag or default key. The proprietary binary's current publisher URL is unavailable; downloaded legacy software was statically inspected and not added as a dependency.
skills_v2.commit_message: Add Free File Camouflage forensic workflow
